title: Provision VPC with Public and Private Subnets
description:
We need a new AWS VPC in us-east-1 for the payments service.

Requirements:
- CIDR 10.10.0.0/16
- 2 public subnets (10.10.1.0/24, 10.10.2.0/24) in AZs us-east-1a and us-east-1b
- 2 private subnets (10.10.10.0/24, 10.10.20.0/24)
- Internet Gateway attached to public subnets
- NAT Gateway in each public subnet for private subnet egress
- Security group: allow HTTPS inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on public subnets
- Deny all inbound on private subnets
- VPC Flow Logs enabled, shipped to CloudWatch Logs
- All resources tagged: Environment=prod, Team=payments, CostCenter=CC-402
context: This VPC will host the payments ECS cluster. Account: 123456789012 in us-east-1. Use Terraform module: terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws version ~> 5.0
